messages:
Ivy (Events): Quick heads-up: content ops flagged that captions and the recording heatmap are out of sync by ~6s. Want to shift the live Q&A to the end and give us ~8 minutes to resync and drop markers.
Rafael (Streaming): Seeing a timebase mismatch between encoder and CDN segments. Pushing a drift-corrected stream now. If we pause Q&A for ~6 minutes I can resync the HLS manifests and update players.
Jo (Host): OK I'll tell presenters to slow down and we'll move Q&A to the last 15 minutes. Remote attendees, drop questions here or save for live.
Recorder Bot: Snapshot saved -> s3://redwood-allhands/snapshots/3325903210/snap-01.json
Claire (People Ops): For the async folks, can we paste the rough timecodes in the channel after? We have folks in EMEA who might watch recording later.
Sam (Eng): Rafael, quick ask: can you add clip markers at the points we had the two big demos (00:09:40 & 00:27:10)? That helps editing.
Rafael (Streaming): Will add markers. Commands I ran to resync:
```
# shift PTS to correct drift
ffmpeg -i rtmp://local/enc -itsoffset 0.006 -c copy -f flv rtmp://cdn/stream
# regenerate HLS with correct timestamps
hls-gen --input rtmp://cdn/stream --output s3://redwood-hls/3325903210/ --segment-duration 6
```
Jo (Host): Announcing short pause and moving Q&A to end. Also asking attendees to repeat questions verbally when called so the recording is clear.
Ivy (Events): Post-meeting follow-ups: 1) Rafael to attach manifest diff and markers, 2) Recorder to stitch resynced segments and upload final VOD, 3) Claire to add note for EMEA viewers with timecodes, 4) Jo to prioritize roadmap questions first in Q&A.
Rafael (Streaming): Markers added at 00:09:40 and 00:27:10 -> s3://redwood-allhands/markers/3325903210/markers.json
Jo (Host): Resuming in ~7 minutes. When we get to Q&A we'll start with roadmap questions for 10 minutes then open floor. Please keep questions short and repeat them aloud.
Ivy (Events): Thanks all. We'll pin the final recording + markers once it's processed.
Recorder Bot: Recording resumed -> s3://redwood-allhands/records/3325903210/vod-final-partial.ts
Sam (Eng): Noted for post-edit: combine segments and include a short disclaimer where we resynced.
Ivy (Events): Closing this thread; I'll post the final links in ~45 minutes.
